repos.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repos.summary_zh: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的安全工作流自动化平台，融合可视化拖拽与自定义代码（JavaScript/Python），支持 400+ 集成和原生 AI 能力（基于 LangChain），提供自托管或云端部署选项，采用公平源代码许可，确保数据控制与可定制性。
repos.summary_en: n8n is a secure workflow automation platform combining visual building with custom code (JavaScript/Python), offering 400+ integrations, native AI capabilities via LangChain, and flexible deployment options—self-hosted or cloud—under a fair-code license for full data control and extensibility.

repos.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
repos.summary_zh: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Langflow 是一个强大的 AI 智能体与工作流构建平台，提供可视化拖拽界面和 Python 源码级定制能力。支持多智能体编排、API/MCP 部署、LangSmith 可观测性集成，内置主流 LLM 与向量数据库支持，适用于企业级 AI 应用快速开发与部署。
repos.summary_en: Langflow is a powerful platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. It offers a visual builder interface, source code customization in Python, multi-agent orchestration, API/MCP deployment, LangSmith observability, and native support for major LLMs and vector databases, making it ideal for rapid enterprise-grade AI application development.

repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.summary_zh: free-for.dev 是一个面向开发者和运维人员的精选免费服务清单，涵盖 SaaS、PaaS、IaaS 等基础设施类工具。该列表聚焦于 DevOps 和系统管理员常用服务，强调长期可用的免费层级（非试用），并排除自托管软件。内容由社区协作维护，包含云管理、CI/CD、监控、安全等 30+ 个分类，帮助开发者快速发现并评估适合的免费资源。
repos.summary_en: free-for.dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS services tailored for developers and infrastructure teams. It focuses on tools useful for DevOps, sysadmins, and cloud engineers, excluding self-hosted software and limited-time trials. Maintained by a community of 1600+ contributors, it covers 30+ categories including cloud management, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and more, enabling informed decisions about free developer offerings.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share.
repos.summary_zh: Memos 是一款开源、自托管的快速笔记工具，专为即时记录设计。原生支持 Markdown，轻量高效，完全由用户掌控数据。提供简洁的时间线界面，无需分类导航，单命令部署，支持 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL，具备完整的 REST/gRPC API，适合个人知识管理和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool designed for instant capture. Native Markdown support, lightweight (~20MB Docker image), and full data ownership with zero telemetry. Features timeline-first UI, single binary deployment, and extensible via REST/gRPC APIs for personal knowledge management and team use.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一个统一的 AI 模型聚合与分发平台，支持将各类大语言模型转换为 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容格式，提供个人与企业级的中心化模型管理网关。
repos.summary_en: New API is a unified AI model hub for aggregation and distribution, supporting cross-conversion of various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It serves as a centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

repos.description: A pure Unix shell script ACME client for SSL / TLS certificate automation
repos.summary_zh: acme.sh 是一个纯 Unix shell 脚本实现的 ACME 客户端，用于自动化 SSL/TLS 证书申请与续期。支持 ECDSA、通配符和多域名证书，兼容主流操作系统和容器环境，部署简单，仅需3分钟掌握，是运维自动化的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: acme.sh is a pure Unix shell script ACME client for automating SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal. It supports ECDSA, wildcard, and SAN certificates, runs on major OS platforms and containers, and is easy to deploy—masterable in just 3 minutes for efficient DevOps automation.

repos.description: 🌐 The Internet Computer! Free, Open-Source, and Self-Hostable.
repos.summary_zh: Puter 是一个开源的个人互联网操作系统，提供文件管理、应用商店和远程桌面功能，支持自托管与云端部署。它具备隐私优先的云存储能力，可作为 Dropbox 或 Google Drive 的替代方案，同时支持网站、Web 应用和游戏的开发与发布，适用于个人云、服务器管理和学习分布式系统。
repos.summary_en: Puter is an open-source personal internet OS offering file management, app store, and remote desktop capabilities. It supports self-hosting and cloud deployment, functioning as a privacy-focused alternative to services like Dropbox or Google Drive, while enabling web app development and distributed system learning.

repos.description: The self-driving agent platform
repos.summary_zh: Agno 是一个专为构建、运行和管理大规模智能体软件而设计的运行时框架。它支持构建具备记忆、知识库、防护机制和百种集成的智能体，提供 FastAPI 后端服务，实现状态化智能体的生产级部署与监控，并通过 AgentOS UI 提供测试、管理和追踪功能。
repos.summary_en: Agno is a runtime framework for building, running, and managing agentic software at scale. It enables creation of stateful agents with memory, knowledge, guardrails, and 100+ integrations, serving them via a stateless FastAPI backend in production, with monitoring and management through the AgentOS UI.

repos.description: Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes
repos.summary_zh: Trilium Notes 是一款免费开源的跨平台笔记应用，支持构建大型个人知识库。其核心功能包括无限层级树状结构、富文本与 Markdown 编辑器、代码高亮、全文搜索、版本控制及多位置克隆笔记，适用于知识管理与结构化信息存储。
repos.summary_en: Trilium Notes is a free, open-source, cross-platform note-taking app focused on building large personal knowledge bases. It features hierarchical notes with cloning support, rich WYSIWYG editing (including math and code syntax highlighting), full-text search, versioning, and seamless navigation.

repos.description: Vane is an AI-powered answering engine.
repos.summary_zh: Vane 是一个隐私优先的 AI 问答引擎，支持本地 LLM（Ollama）和云端大模型（OpenAI、Claude、Groq），结合互联网知识库与 SearxNG 网页搜索，提供带引用来源的精准回答。支持文件上传、多模态搜索、智能建议及本地历史记录，所有数据在本地处理以保障隐私。
repos.summary_en: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your hardware, combining internet knowledge with local LLMs (Ollama) and cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude, Groq). It delivers cited answers via SearxNG-powered web search, supports file uploads, multimodal content, smart suggestions, and maintains local search history—all while keeping data private.

repos.description: 🌩 Self-hosted file management and sharing system, supports multiple storage providers
repos.summary_zh: Cloudreve 是一个自托管文件管理与共享系统，支持对接本地、OneDrive、S3、七牛云、阿里云OSS等十余种存储后端。提供 WebDAV、在线预览、拖拽上传、批量下载、多用户权限管理等功能，开箱即用，适合企业或个人私有云部署。
repos.summary_en: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system supporting multiple storage backends like Local, OneDrive, S3, Qiniu, Aliyun OSS, etc. It offers features such as WebDAV, online preview, drag-and-drop upload, batch download, multi-user/group access control, and is ready-to-use for private cloud deployment.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控工具，支持自然语言创建任务、多模态商品分析、定时调度与智能筛选。提供完整 Web 管理界面，集成 ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram 通知，支持 Docker 一键部署与账号代理轮换，帮助用户高效发现目标商品。
repos.summary_en: AI-powered Xianyu monitoring system using Playwright for real-time/periodic multi-task tracking and analysis. Features natural language task creation, multimodal product analysis, cron scheduling, advanced filters (region/price/new-post), and full web UI with notifications via ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram. Supports Docker deployment, account rotation, and proxy management.

repos.description: Notion-style WYSIWYG editor with AI-powered autocompletion.
repos.summary_zh: Novel 是一个开源的类 Notion WYSIWYG 编辑器，支持 AI 驱动的自动补全功能。基于 Next.js 和 Tiptap 构建，集成 OpenAI API 实现智能文本补全，提供类似 Notion 的流畅编辑体验，支持跨平台部署与扩展。
repos.summary_en: Novel is an open-source Notion-style WYSIWYG editor featuring AI-powered autocompletion. Built with Next.js and Tiptap, it integrates OpenAI APIs for intelligent text suggestions, offering a seamless editing experience akin to Notion, with cross-platform deployment and extensibility.

repos.description: 🔥 The open-source no-code platform for web scraping, crawling, search and AI data extraction • Turn websites into structured APIs in minutes 🔥
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: An open-source, self-hosted personal AI note tool prioritizing privacy, built using TypeScript .
repos.summary_zh: Blinko 是一款开源的个人 AI 笔记工具，采用 TypeScript 和 Tauri 构建，支持自托管以保障数据隐私。其核心亮点包括基于 RAG 技术的自然语言检索、轻量级跨平台部署（支持 macOS/Windows/Android/Linux）以及 Markdown 编辑功能，让用户能快速捕捉并管理创意想法。
repos.summary_en: Blinko is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI note-taking tool built with TypeScript and Tauri. It emphasizes privacy through local data storage and offers AI-powered RAG-based retrieval, lightweight cross-platform support (macOS/Windows/Android/Linux), and Markdown editing for instant idea capture and organization.

repos.description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
repos.summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
repos.summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

repos.description: A modern self-hosted music player.
repos.summary_zh: Feishin 是一款现代化的自托管音乐播放器，支持 MPV 和 Web 播放器后端，提供现代化 UI、智能播放列表编辑、歌词同步与反同步功能，并支持将播放记录同步至服务器，适用于个人音乐库管理与流媒体播放。
repos.summary_en: Feishin is a modern self-hosted music player featuring MPV and web player backends, a sleek UI, smart playlist editing, synchronized lyrics, and playback scrobbling to your server, ideal for managing personal music libraries and streaming.

repos.description: The Enterprise-Grade Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework. Website: https://swarms.ai
repos.summary_zh: Swarms 是一个企业级生产就绪的多智能体编排框架，专为大规模部署设计。它提供高可用微服务架构、分层智能体集群管理、并行与顺序工作流编排，并支持与 LangChain、AutoGen 等主流框架无缝集成，适用于复杂业务流程自动化和分布式 AI 系统构建。
repos.summary_en: Swarms is an enterprise-grade, production-ready multi-agent orchestration framework designed for scalable deployments. It features high-availability microservices architecture, hierarchical agent swarms, parallel/sequential workflow orchestration, and seamless integration with LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI, enabling complex business process automation and distributed AI systems.

repos.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是对 ChatGPT 官网能力逆向封装的 OpenAI 兼容 API 代理，支持文生图、图片编辑与多图组图功能，集成号池管理、多种账号导入方式及 Docker 自托管部署，提供完整的在线画图工作台与缓存机制。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that reverse-engineers ChatGPT's image generation and editing capabilities, featuring account pool management, multi-import methods, Docker deployment, and a built-in online drawing workspace with caching support.

repos.description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
repos.summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
repos.summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: DeepSeek-Compatible Middleware Interface: A technical exploration project in Go, focusing on high-concurrency protocol adaptation. It serves as a reference implementation for converting diverse web protocols into standardized formats.
repos.summary_zh: DS2API 是一个高性能 DeepSeek Web 对话能力转换 API，支持 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容接口。采用 Go 全量实现后端，React 构建管理后台，具备多账号轮询、PoW 验证、Tool Calling 防泄漏处理等核心功能，支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，并提供完整的后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: DS2API is a high-performance API that converts DeepSeek Web chat capabilities into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini compatible interfaces. Built with full Go backend implementation and React admin UI, it features multi-account polling, PoW verification, Tool Calling protection, and supports deployment via Docker/Vercel. Includes complete management system with account testing and configuration sync.

repos.description: A lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.description: 发现导航，好用强大轻量级导航网站 Discover navigation, easy to use, powerful lightweight navigation website
repos.summary_zh: 发现导航是一个纯静态、支持SEO的轻量级导航网站，内置800+优质网站资源。它无需数据库和服务器，支持在线编辑、AI翻译、书签导入导出、暗黑模式、多主题切换及响应式设计，提供后台管理及自动化部署功能，适用于个人或企业内网统一链接管理。
repos.summary_en: Discover Navigation is a pure static, SEO-friendly lightweight navigation website featuring over 800 curated sites. Built without databases or servers, it supports online editing, AI translation, bookmark import/export, dark mode, multi-theme switching, responsive design, admin panel, and automated deployment—ideal for personal or enterprise internal link management.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: 发现导航 , 好用强大轻量级导航网站 Discover navigation, easy to use, powerful lightweight navigation website
repos.summary_zh: 发现导航是一个纯静态、支持SEO的轻量级导航网站，内置800+优质链接，具备AI翻译、书签导入导出、多主题切换、暗黑模式、响应式设计等强大功能，支持无服务器部署和在线管理，适用于个人或企业内网导航。
repos.summary_en: Discover Navigation is a pure static, SEO-friendly lightweight navigation site with 800+ curated links. It features AI translation, bookmark import/export, multi-theme support, dark mode, responsive design, and no-server deployment, suitable for personal or enterprise internal navigation.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: One Hub All LLMs For You | 为个人打造的 LLM API 聚合网关
repos.summary_zh: Octopus 是一款为个人用户设计的 LLM API 聚合服务，支持多通道接入、智能负载均衡与协议转换。具备统一密钥管理、自动模型同步、价格追踪及多数据库支持（SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL），提供美观的 Web 管理面板和全面的请求分析功能，实现高效稳定的 AI 接口统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Octopus is a personal LLM API aggregation service that unifies multiple provider channels with intelligent load balancing and protocol conversion. It supports multi-key management, automatic model/pricing sync, comprehensive analytics, and elegant UI, with multi-database support (SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL) for stable and efficient AI interface management.

repos.description: 一站式域名服务平台，集成短链生成、无限域名邮箱、文件存储和子域名管理，带有管理员面板，支持自部署
repos.summary_zh: WR.DO 是一个功能强大的自托管域名服务平台，集成短链生成、无限域名邮箱、子域名管理、多平台文件存储和开放API接口。支持自定义短链、密码保护、访问统计、邮件推送等功能，提供完整的管理员面板，适合个人或企业自建域名服务基础设施。
repos.summary_en: WR.DO is a comprehensive self-hosted domain platform integrating short link generation, unlimited domain email, subdomain management, multi-cloud file storage, and open APIs. It supports custom links, password protection, analytics, email notifications, and provides a full admin panel for building private domain infrastructure.

repos.description: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory.  You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.
repos.summary_zh: Memoh 是一个自托管的容器化 AI 智能体平台，支持创建多个具备长期记忆能力的独立机器人。通过 Docker 实现容器级隔离，可连接 Telegram、Discord、Feishu（Lark）、Matrix 等通信渠道，提供图形化配置界面和 MCP 工具调用能力，适用于家庭或团队的多成员协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Memoh is a self-hosted, containerized AI agent platform enabling multiple bots with persistent long-term memory. Each bot runs in isolated containers and integrates with platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu (Lark), and Matrix via a web UI, supporting role-based access and cross-platform identity recognition for team or family use.

repos.description: Deploy your private Gemini application for free with one click, supporting Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0 models.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Next Chat 是一个开源的 Gemini AI 聊天框架，支持一键免费部署私有应用，兼容 Gemini 1.5/2.0 系列模型。基于 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 构建，提供 Web、桌面多端支持，具备函数调用扩展能力，适用于企业级私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Next Chat is an open-source, extensible chatbot framework for Gemini AI models (1.5/2.0). Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it enables one-click free deployment of private web applications across Web, MacOS, Windows, and Linux platforms with function calling support.

repos.description: 自部署的摄影作品网站，支持多种功能特性。PicImpact，分享你和世界！
repos.summary_zh: PicImpact 是一个基于 Next.js + Hono.js 的自部署摄影作品展示网站，支持瀑布流相册、WebGL 高性能图片查看器（含实况照片与分块加载）、地图标记、EXIF 信息展示、双因素认证、Passkey 无密码登录及多存储后端兼容。具备响应式设计、暗黑模式、RSS 订阅与自动化上传功能，适合个人或团队搭建专业图库平台。
repos.summary_en: PicImpact is a self-deployable photography portfolio built with Next.js and Hono.js, featuring a masonry gallery, WebGL-powered image viewer (with Live Photos support), EXIF-based geotagging, TOTP/Passkey authentication, multi-storage backend compatibility, RSS feeds, and responsive design. Ideal for creators to showcase high-resolution images with performance optimization.

repos.description: 基于官方OpenWebUI，汉化界面提高中文使用体验，增加了模型计费和用量统计
repos.summary_zh: HaloWebUI 是基于 Open WebUI 深度定制的中文 AI 自托管平台，集成 Claude/Gemini/xAI 等多模型路由与知识检索增强功能。提供原生中文界面、模型计费统计及 HaloClaw 消息网关，支持 Docker 一键部署与全链路可控的对话管理。
repos.summary_en: HaloWebUI is a Chinese-localized self-hosted AI platform built on Open WebUI, featuring multi-model routing (Claude/Gemini/xAI), knowledge retrieval enhancement, and cost tracking. It includes native Chinese UI, HaloClaw message gateway, and Docker deployment support for full conversational control.

repos.description: 可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署，内置多用户管理，适合企业、团队或个人快速构建 AI 服务。
repos.summary_zh: 99AI 是一个可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署与多用户管理，集成 AI 对话、深度思考、联网搜索、智能图表生成及自定义应用广场等功能，适用于企业、团队或个人快速构建商业化 AI 服务。
repos.summary_en: 99AI is a commercializable AI web platform offering an all-in-one AI service solution. It supports private deployment, multi-user management, and integrates features like AI chat, deep thinking models, web search, intelligent diagram generation, and customizable agent apps for rapid enterprise or team AI service development.

repos.description: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Worker 的免费网页归档与分享服务，提供浏览器插件、云端存储和检索功能。支持单文件 HTML 保存、文件夹分类、AI 标签生成及移动端适配，实现网页内容的永久存档与便捷共享。
repos.summary_en: A free web archiving and sharing service built on Cloudflare Workers, featuring a browser plugin for saving webpages as single HTML files, cloud-based storage with D1 database and R2 bucket, AI-generated tags, folder organization, and mobile-optimized reading mode.

repos.description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
repos.summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
repos.summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

repos.description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

repos.description: TTSFM mirrors OpenAI's TTS service, providing a compatible interface for text-to-speech conversion with multiple voice options for free.
repos.summary_zh: TTSFM 是一个免费的 OpenAI 兼容文本转语音 API 服务，基于 OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS 提供多语音选项、6种音频格式支持、速度调节和实时流式生成，包含 Python SDK、Web 交互界面及 Docker 部署方案，适用于教育与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: TTSFM is a free, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech API service based on OpenAI's GPT-4o mini TTS, offering 11 voice options, 6 audio formats, speed control (0.25x–4.0x), real-time streaming, Python SDK, web playground, and Docker deployment for educational and research use.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理服务，支持 Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV 一键部署，提供流/非流式对话、图像生成、深度思考等功能。具备号池并发、自动负载均衡、Token/API Key 管理、后台面板等核心能力，三端部署行为一致，适配移动端并增强筛选与状态判定逻辑。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based proxy for Grok AI, supporting one-click deployment on Cloudflare Workers/D1+KV with streaming/non-streaming chat, image generation, deep thinking, concurrent token pools, and auto load balancing. It features unified management panels, mobile adaptation, enhanced token filtering, and consistent behavior across local/FastAPI/Docker/Workers deployments.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: Python项目自动化多服务器部署的工具
repos.summary_zh: essay 是一个基于 Fabric 的 Python 项目自动化部署工具，支持多服务器打包与部署。它通过标准化流程简化开发到生产环境的交付，集成 PyPI 服务器和 Git 仓库，提供快速构建、版本化打包、虚拟环境管理及 Supervisord 进程控制，适用于需高效扩展的 Python 服务场景。
repos.summary_en: Essay is a Python project automation deployment tool based on Fabric, supporting multi-server packaging and deployment. It streamlines the development-to-production pipeline with standardized workflows, integrating PyPI servers and Git repositories. It enables rapid builds, versioned packaging, virtual environment management, and Supervisord process control, ideal for scalable Python service deployments.

repos.description: TTS Azure Web 是一个 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，可以在本地或者云端使用你的 Azure Key 一键部署。TTS Azure Web is an Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS) web application. It allows you to run it locally or deploy it with a single click using your Azure Key.
repos.summary_zh: TTS Azure Web 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 React 19 的 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，支持 SSML 精细调优、多语言语音定制及一键部署。提供 Normal/SSML 双模式切换、音频参数调节与导出功能，适用于快速集成 Azure TTS 能力至本地或云端环境。
repos.summary_en: TTS Azure Web is a Next.js 15 and React 19-based web application for Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS), enabling fine-grained voice control via SSML. It supports dual-mode operation (UI/SSML), audio export, and one-click deployment with Azure credentials, ideal for rapid integration of Azure TTS into local or cloud environments.

repos.description: 基于 n8n 的中文本地化版本（chs 分支持续跟进官方）—— AI 智能体与工作流自动化
repos.summary_zh: n8n 是一款面向技术团队的工作流自动化平台，支持可视化拖拽与代码级灵活控制（JavaScript/Python），集成400+工具并原生支持AI代理工作流。采用公平代码许可证，提供自托管与云服务选项，具备企业级权限管理、SSO及多数据库支持，适合构建复杂自动化流程。
repos.summary_en: n8n is a workflow automation platform for technical teams, offering both visual drag-and-drop and code-level flexibility (JavaScript/Python). With 400+ integrations, native AI agent workflows via LangChain, and a fair-code license, it supports self-hosting or cloud deployment, featuring enterprise-grade permissions, SSO, and multi-database compatibility for complex automation.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级两步验证密钥管理系统，支持 TOTP/HOTP 生成、多方式添加密钥（扫码/图片识别/拖拽/粘贴）、AES-256-GCM 加密存储，兼容主流应用批量导入导出，具备 WebDAV/S3 远程同步、自动备份还原及响应式设计，实现免费全球部署与离线 PWA 使用。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight two-factor authentication (2FA) key management system built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TOTP/HOTP generation, multi-method key addition (QR scan/image recognition/drag-and-drop/paste), AES-256-GCM encryption, batch import/export from major apps, WebDAV/S3 sync, auto backup/restore, and responsive design for offline PWA use with global free deployment.

repos.description: AI 每日新闻简报 · GitHub 热门 + X 热门文章 + 行情技术分析 · 23 个数据源聚合 + LLM 中文摘要 · 本地或 GitHub Actions 部署
repos.summary_zh: DailyBrief 是一款 AI 驱动的每日新闻简报工具，聚合 GitHub、X（推特）、财经及国际媒体等 23 个数据源，支持 21 个股票/加密标的的技术指标与 LLM 中文摘要。核心亮点包括：5 种可插拔 LLM 后端（Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax）、中英双语支持、零基础设施的 GitHub Actions 一键部署，以及单文件 HTML 无依赖输出。适用于个人投资者、技术极客及资讯聚合场景，实现自动化、个性化的每日简报生成。
repos.summary_en: DailyBrief is an AI-powered daily news briefing tool that aggregates content from 23 sources including GitHub, X (Twitter), financial and international media. It features real-time technical indicators for 21 stocks/crypto assets with LLM-generated Chinese summaries. Key highlights: 5 plug-and-play LLM backends (Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax), bilingual support, zero-infrastructure deployment via GitHub Actions, and standalone HTML output. Ideal for investors, tech enthusiasts, and automated information aggregation.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

repos.description: 基于deno的抖音视频图文无水印下载，支持cf worker,vercel,deno deploy,docker部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Deno 的抖音无水印视频与图文下载服务，支持多平台部署（Deno Deploy、Cloudflare Workers、Vercel、Docker），通过简单 API 调用即可解析并返回原始媒体链接，适用于内容抓取与自动化处理场景。
repos.summary_en: A Deno-based service for downloading watermark-free Douyin videos and images via URL parsing, supporting deployment on Deno Deploy, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and Docker. Provides clean media links through a simple GET API for content extraction and automation.

repos.description: Django project template layout
repos.summary_zh: django-layout 是一个基于最佳实践的 Django 项目模板，提供开箱即用的现代化开发体验。集成 uv 依赖管理、ruff/prettier 代码规范、goodconf 环境配置、结构化日志、TailwindCSS 样式方案、pytest 测试框架及 mypy 类型检查，支持 Docker 部署，显著提升 Django 项目初始化效率与生产环境健壮性。
repos.summary_en: django-layout is a modern Django project template offering sane defaults based on best practices. It integrates uv for dependency management, ruff/prettier for linting, goodconf for config, structured logging, TailwindCSS, pytest with coverage, mypy for type safety, and production-ready settings via Docker, streamlining Django project setup and deployment.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: 个人基于chenyme Grok2API的修改版本，在原版基础上支持nsfw全程工作流，视频工作台循环拼接，夜间模式和移动端UI适配等
repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 是基于 FastAPI 的个人化 Grok API 部署项目，支持 NSFW 工作流、视频拼接、夜间模式及移动端适配。提供 Docker/Render/Vercel 多平台一键部署，兼容本地与云端存储，适用于个人开发、API 集成及私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a personal deployment of Grok API based on FastAPI, supporting NSFW workflows, video stitching, dark mode, and mobile UI. It offers one-click deployment via Docker/Render/Vercel with support for local or remote storage, ideal for private development, API integration, and self-hosted use.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr; alternate
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.description: Mynah — self-hosted realtime digital human. One GPU, full admin console, Apache-2.0. 自己服务器上的实时数字人系统
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: 可同时输入多个初版提示词，开启多轮自动优化，连续得到高分后得到最终结果。
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer Studio 是一款自托管提示词优化工作台，支持多轮自动优化与人工干预。用户可输入初版 prompt，系统通过复核与生成机制持续迭代，最终输出可直接复用的完整提示词，适用于企业级 AI 应用开发与提示工程场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer Studio is a self-hosted prompt optimization studio that enables multi-round automated refinement with human-in-the-loop control. Users input initial prompts, and the system iteratively optimizes them through review and generation cycles, delivering a final, copy-paste-ready prompt for enterprise AI development and prompt engineering workflows.

repos.description: serv00和ct8主机一键安装哪吒探针和多主机保活
repos.summary_zh: 专为serv00和ct8低配主机设计的一键安装脚本，支持哪吒探针v0/v1版本自动部署、多主机SSH密钥保活及进程监控。通过crontab实现探针进程自愈与跨主机联动保活，集成企业微信/Telegram通知、云存储数据库备份等功能，显著提升探针面板稳定性。
repos.summary_en: A specialized one-click installer for serv00 and ct8 low-end hosts, enabling automatic deployment of Nezha Probe v0/v1 dashboards/agents with multi-host SSH key-based survival. Features crontab-driven process monitoring, cross-host recovery, enterprise WeChat/Telegram alerts, and cloud database backups to enhance probe stability.

repos.description: Yet another django based blog created in May 2015
repos.summary_zh: MayBlog 是一个基于 Django 和 Bootstrap 开发的博客系统，于2015年5月创建。支持多用户、多角色、Markdown 写作、SEO 优化，并通过 Docker 实现容器化部署。提供 RESTful API（开发中）和后台管理界面，采用微服务架构设计，适合个人或团队搭建内容管理平台。
repos.summary_en: MayBlog is a Django and Bootstrap-based blog system created in May 2015. It supports multi-user, multi-role access, Markdown writing, SEO optimization, and containerized deployment via Docker. Features include RESTful API (in development), admin interface, and modular deployment configurations, ideal for personal or team content management.

repos.description: 文科生也会配的微信个人号后台，Content based wechat massive platform framework, what you need to do is only adding your articles in :)
repos.summary_zh: MyPlatform 是一个专为非技术用户设计的微信个人号内容管理平台，支持通过添加文章快速搭建微信公众号。基于 Python 开发，部署于新浪云（SAE），完全免费且配置简单，文科生也可在20分钟内完成搭建，实现内容分发与互动功能。
repos.summary_en: MyPlatform is a content-based WeChat personal account backend framework designed for non-technical users. Built with Python and hosted on SAE, it enables quick setup by adding articles, allowing anyone to create a functional WeChat content platform in under 20 minutes with zero cost.

repos.description: Deployed on Cloudflare Worker, using the free Flux model and optimizing prompts with LLM. It can be called from any application compatible with the OpenAI API. 部署于Cloudflare Worker，免费使用Flux模型，并通过LLM进行提示词优化，支持在任何兼容OpenAI API的应用中调用。
repos.summary_zh: Flux-API-Worker 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Worker 上的 AI 图像生成服务，免费使用 Flux 模型并通过 LLM 优化提示词，提供兼容 OpenAI API 的接口，支持自定义提示、多尺寸输出、KV 缓存及 CORS，适用于各类应用集成。
repos.summary_en: Flux-API-Worker is an AI image generation service deployed on Cloudflare Workers, utilizing the free Flux model and LLM-powered prompt optimization. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless integration into any application, supporting custom prompts, multiple aspect ratios, KV storage, and streaming responses.

repos.description: Self-hosted temporary email platform with SMTP receiving, verification code extraction, domain management, and API access.
repos.summary_zh: ShiroMail 是一个自托管的临时邮箱平台，支持实时 SMTP 邮件接收、验证码自动提取、域名管理、API 访问及管理员控制台。基于 Go + Gin + React + MySQL/Redis 构建，提供完整的邮箱生命周期管理、消息解析规则配置和自动化接口，适用于需要临时邮箱验证或测试的场景。
repos.summary_en: ShiroMail is a self-hosted temporary email platform featuring real-time SMTP ingestion, verification code extraction, domain management, API access, and an admin console. Built with Go, Gin, React, and MySQL/Redis, it offers full mailbox lifecycle control, message parsing rules, and automation APIs for testing or validation workflows.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: 通过可视化向导，根据你的开发技术栈，选择配置好Skills，MCP，Agent的AI开发工具，一键生成容器化Vibe开发环境。
repos.summary_zh: VibeSpace 是一款可视化 AI 开发环境配置工具，通过向导式界面快速生成生产可用的容器化开发环境。支持多语言（Go/Node.js/Python/Rust/Java/C++）、AI 工具（Claude Code/Roo）集成、MCP Server 配置及工作流预设，内置国内镜像源优化，一键输出 Dockerfile、docker-compose.yml 等部署文件，实现安全隔离的 Vibe Coding 开发体验。
repos.summary_en: VibeSpace is a visual configuration tool that generates production-ready containerized AI development environments. It supports multi-language setups (Go, Node.js, Python, Rust, Java, C/C++), integrates AI tools like Claude Code and Roo with MCP servers and workflows, auto-configures domestic mirrors for China users, and outputs deployable Docker artifacts via a guided UI—enabling secure, no-enter Vibe Coding.

repos.description: HF Space Manager 是一个用于管理 Hugging Face Spaces 的 Web 应用程序。它提供了直观的界面和API 接口，让你能够方便地查看和管理多个账号下的所有 Spaces。
repos.summary_zh: HF Space Manager 是一个专为 Hugging Face Spaces 设计的现代化监控管理平台，支持多账号 Spaces 实时状态监控、资源使用统计及远程操作（重启/重建）。采用赛博朋克风格界面，集成 Docker 部署与 RESTful API，提供权限分级控制，适用于个人或团队高效管理 AI 模型部署实例。
repos.summary_en: HF Space Manager is a modern web application for monitoring and managing Hugging Face Spaces instances. It offers real-time status tracking, resource usage metrics (CPU/memory), and remote operations (restart/rebuild) across multiple accounts. Features include a cyberpunk-themed UI, Docker deployment, role-based access control, and a secure REST API for external integrations.

repos.description: 工作生活的唠叨/随笔、折腾备忘, 同时分享下观看的影视、减肥动起来的记录等。Hugo theme and personal blog system with essays, microblog-style updates, browser publishing and life data.
repos.summary_zh: Koobai/blog 是一个个人博客仓库，专注于记录工作生活感悟、技术折腾笔记及日常软件推荐。内容涵盖影视观后感、减肥健身打卡等生活化主题，兼具实用性与分享性，适合追求轻量化知识沉淀与兴趣交流的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Koobai/blog is a personal blog repository focused on daily life musings, technical experimentation notes, and software recommendations. It covers topics like movie reviews, fitness tracking, and lifestyle tips, offering a blend of practical insights and casual sharing for developers seeking lightweight knowledge documentation.

repos.description: MCP Server Unified Deployment Open Source Project
repos.summary_zh: MCP服务器统一部署工具是一个开源项目，旨在将不同形式的MCP服务器（如uvx、npx等）转换为标准化的SSE协议部署，实现多服务器统一管理。支持跨平台运行，提供灵活的配置选项和完整的Docker部署方案，适用于生产环境和大规模管理场景。
repos.summary_en: MCP Server Unified Deployment is an open-source tool that standardizes various MCP server implementations (e.g., uvx, npx) into a unified SSE protocol deployment. It enables centralized management of multiple MCP servers across platforms with flexible configuration and comprehensive Docker support for production environments.

repos.description: Self-hostable NGINX module that serves Markdown to AI agents via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), powered by a Rust converter.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个自托管的 NGINX 模块，通过 HTTP 内容协商（Accept: text/markdown）将 HTML 页面转换为 Markdown 格式供 AI 智能体读取。基于 Rust 构建，无需修改现有应用即可为浏览器返回原始 HTML，同时为支持 Markdown 的请求提供纯净内容，降低 AI 处理成本。
repos.summary_en: This project is a self-hostable NGINX module that converts HTML to Markdown via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) for AI agents, powered by a Rust converter. It serves clean Markdown only when requested while preserving original HTML for browsers, enabling seamless agent-friendly content delivery without application changes.

repos.description: oag is a lightweight CLI for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command install and   update of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for   consistent setup and faster team collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: oag 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，用于管理基于 Git 的 AI 资产注册中心，支持一键安装、更新代理、技能及 MCP 配置到 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode 等本地环境，提升团队协作效率与配置一致性。
repos.summary_en: oag is a lightweight CLI tool for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command installation and updates of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for consistent setup and faster team collaboration.

repos.description: 一个类似于o1的思维过程
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个模拟 GPT-4o1 思维过程的 AI 推理系统，基于 bklieger-groq 的 g1 项目改进而来。支持多步推理、可解释性输出，提供 Streamlit 和 Cloudflare Worker 两种部署方式，兼容多种 LLM（如 Llama-3.1 70b）及 API 服务商，适用于复杂问题分析与决策支持场景。
repos.summary_en: This project simulates the reasoning process of GPT-4o1, extending the original g1-prototype from bklieger-groq. It enables multi-step, interpretable inference using various large language models (e.g., Llama-3.1 70b) via configurable APIs. Available as both a Streamlit web app and a deployable Cloudflare Worker, it supports real-time step-by-step output for complex problem-solving.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.
